notes.save_migration_decision: No automated migration implemented. Stored day baselines in Declaration/Agreement/CasusBelli from existing saves carry the old (cycle-206 epoch + 365-based) values. After the patch, on first load of an old save: Declaration/Agreement/CasusBelli fields shift by up to 206*5=1030 days one-time (main P2 risk — short-duration records may briefly appear expired or have wrong time-remaining, self-heals next load). AIProposalManager.lastProposalDay values will appear ~74000 days in the past so all AI proposal cooldowns expire on first load (AI proposals may spike for ~1 cycle). FactionMemory/Policy/VassalRelation gameDays/day baselines: decay uses elapsed-days (not baseline subtraction) so old records are unaffected in behavior. isLegacyDayValue(>1e6) threshold remains valid. Full per-record migration deferred per PRD scope.
